rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the tunnel.
TNL1O marker bytes are present in a captured frame; decode the full OPEN message separately.
TNL1D marker bytes are present in a captured frame; decode session and length separately.
TNL1C marker bytes are present in a captured frame; correlate the closed session.
At least five payload-bearing TCP segments are present; segment count does not establish multiplexing.

manual_checks: R1 R2: Decode the TNL1 header, type, session ID, service ID and length from the reassembled stream.
R3 R4 R5: Correlate session IDs, payload boundaries and each target response. Segment counts do not prove multiplexing.
